analysis.reasoning: The earnings call was exceptionally positive, characterized by record-breaking revenue growth and the successful launch of the Blackwell architecture. Management demonstrated extreme confidence, particularly Jensen Huang, regarding new scaling laws (post-training and inference-time scaling) that will drive massive future demand. While there were minor mentions of supply constraints in gaming and export controls in China, the overall tone was one of unprecedented momentum. The CFO provided specific guidance on gross margin trajectories (moving from low 70s back to mid-70s), and the technical depth regarding 'Reasoning AI' and 'Physical AI' suggests a very strong innovation moat. The only slight uncertainty noted was the impact of potential future tariffs/regulations, which management addressed cautiously.
